title: ‘개발 인허가 사기’ 최용규 전 의원 징역 2년…법정구속
caption:
A former South Korean lawmaker has been sentenced to two years in prison for taking 700 million won under the false pretense of securing a park development permit. The court ruled that he abused his professional background to defraud a construction company executive.
